entries.name: ExternalCallGateway
entries.description: Gateway executing pool-authorized external calls against an allowlist of target addresses and function selectors, with optional input/output token constraints. Enforces proof-bound settlement receipts and redeposits returned funds into the pool.

paused.description: Whether new external gateway execution is paused.

pool.description: PrivacyBoost pool authorized to execute gateway settlements.

policyEntryAt.description: Installed external call policies: target, function selector, and allowed input/output token IDs (zero permits any token). Targets are external DeFi dependencies and are not recursively discovered.

entries.name: AuthRegistry
entries.description: Registry of PrivacyBoost account authorization keys and onchain spend approvals. Supports BabyJubJub keys authorized by account-owner signatures, approval-only accounts and revocable batches of spend approvals. Tracks current and recently superseded auth roots; forced withdrawals validate live auth records directly.

allowedRelays.description: Relays allowed to submit account key registrations, rotations and revocations signed by account owners.

authTreeDepth.description: Depth of the auth Merkle trees.

authPoseidon.description: External Poseidon2 helper for account IDs, authorization leaves and auth Merkle tree hashing.

MAX_APPROVAL_LIFETIME.description: Maximum lifetime of an onchain spend approval, in seconds.

entries.name: AuditGateway
entries.description: Manages the list of auditors authorized to query private user data through the Audit API of the TEE, and stores an onchain log of every audit access so that users can publicly verify whether and when their private data was disclosed.

auditLogger.description: Address (TEE server wallet) that records every Audit API access on-chain by calling the AuditGateway.

getAllAuditors.description: Auditors authorized to fetch the balance and transaction history of any address through the Audit API of the TEE. Every such access is logged onchain.

auditLogCount.description: Total number of audit accesses logged onchain.

entries.name: PrivacyBoost
entries.description: Main contract of the PrivacyBoost pool. Escrows ERC-20 tokens and verifies relay-submitted private transfer, withdrawal, deposit, portal deposit and gift settlement proofs. Supports approved external gateway calls and permissionless exits through delayed forced withdrawals or public gift exits.

allowedRelays.description: Relays allowed to submit epochs to the pool.

epochVerifier.description: Groth16 verifier used for private transfer / withdrawal epoch proofs.

depositVerifier.description: Groth16 verifier used for deposit epoch proofs.

forcedVerifier.description: Groth16 verifier used for forced withdrawal proofs.

tokenRegistry.description: Registry of ERC-20 tokens accepted by the pool.

authRegistry.description: Registry of account authorization keys and spend approvals used to validate spend authorization.

withdrawFeeBps.description: Withdrawal fee in basis points, charged on withdrawals and forced withdrawals.

cancelDelay.description: Number of blocks after which an unprocessed deposit request can be cancelled and refunded by the depositor.

forcedWithdrawalDelay.description: Number of blocks between requesting and executing a forced withdrawal.

gateways.description: Approved synchronous gateway routes for proof-authorized external calls.

portalMinimumSweeps.description: Minimum gross amount per token ID required for a portal sweep, in token base units; defaults to zero.

portalDepositVerifier.description: Groth16 verifier for portal deposit proofs.

giftClaimVerifier.description: Groth16 verifier for private gift settlement and public gift exit proofs.

maxEpochAuthStalenessBlocks.description: Maximum age in blocks of a superseded auth root accepted for epoch and private gift settlement proofs.

maxForcedWithdrawalAuthStalenessBlocks.description: Maximum age in blocks of a superseded auth root accepted for public gift exits. Despite its legacy name, this does not govern forced withdrawals, which check the live auth record at request time.

portalSweepFeeBps.description: Portal sweep fee in basis points, paid to the sweeper and snapshotted when the deposit is requested.
